trips.name: Guadalajara, Antigua, Little Corn, Medellín
trips.why: Simon's route with Utila cut, as he suggested: Guadalajara, Antigua, El Tunco, Nicaragua with Little Corn for the Advanced course, a week in Medellín, then Cochabamba and Santa Cruz. One ticket CPH to Guadalajara and Santa Cruz to CPH (11.034 kr, 2 Dec 06:45 to 20:45 in 21 h via Paris and Mexico City, home 2 Feb 09:05 to 3 Feb 09:10 in 19.1 h via São Paulo and Paris, no night landings). Cutting Utila saves about 2 long travel days and keeps one island stop.

places.why: Simon's chosen start. Guadalajara is the most Mexican of the big cities: tapatío life, mariachi in Tlaquepaque, cantinas and a Tequila day trip. A soft landing to get the Spanish going.

hop.overland: Aeromexico via Mexico City to Guatemala City, then a 1 h shuttle to Antigua (110 kr).

places.why: 3 to 5 days, as Simon asked. Colonial streets, rooftop bars, Spanish schools and the volcano view. Open to travel around: Lake Atitlán (3 h) and the Acatenango overnight hike.
Surf town of El Salvador with the Thursday to Saturday party nights Simon wants. Open to El Zonte next door for a quieter beach.

hop.overland: Door to door minivan El Tunco to León through Honduras, about 11 to 12 h, from about US$56 to 60, leaves 09:00.

places.why: Christmas in León: a student city with the most local life in Nicaragua, salsa bars, La Purísima and Gritería just before (7 Dec), and volcano boarding on Cerro Negro.
New Year in San Juan del Sur, the big party beach of Nicaragua with locals and backpackers both. Surf beaches north and south.
Granada for colonial streets, salsa nights and Laguna de Apoyo. 75 min from Managua airport, so the morning flight to the Corn Islands is easy.

hop.overland: Shuttle to Managua airport, La Costeña to Big Corn (07:00 or 14:00, about US$100 one way with the new bag fee, repo price 645 kr), panga to Little Corn (10:00 or 16:30, 64 kr). Seats sell out Dec to Apr, so book La Costeña early.

places.why: Little Corn, no cars and no roads. Dolphin Dive does PADI Advanced here, with reef sharks, eagle rays, turtles and a wreck, and calm water with 15 to 30 m visibility. 5 to 7 days as Simon asked.

hop.overland: Panga Little Corn to Big Corn 06:30, La Costeña 08:20 to Managua (645 kr + 64 kr), a night in Managua, then the early flight.

places.why: A week or more in Medellín: salsa in Envigado and Laureles, the metro cable, Comuna 13 and Guatapé. Open to Cali (cheap 1 h flight) for the salsa capital.
Old friends and the city Simon lived in. A few days from about 26 Jan, as he asked.
One full day in Santa Cruz before the flight home from Viru Viru.

trips.name: Guadalajara, El Salvador, Utila, Nicaragua
trips.why: The version that keeps Utila and skips Guatemala and Colombia, as Simon suggested: fly Guadalajara to San Salvador, El Tunco, the Advanced course on Utila, Nicaragua with both León and Granada and fun dives on Little Corn, then fly from Managua to Bolivia. Same ticket as trip A (11.034 kr). More time per stop, at the cost of two long bus days around Utila and no Medellín. Managua to Cochabamba has no good flight: 5.728 kr and 20.8 h with self-transfers, dearer than going via Medellín (1.745 kr plus 2.735 kr).

places.why: Simon's chosen start. Guadalajara is the most Mexican of the big cities: tapatío life, mariachi in Tlaquepaque, cantinas and a Tequila day trip. A soft landing to get the Spanish going.

hop.overland: Copa via Panama, lands San Salvador 20:37, then an 80 min shuttle to El Tunco (281 kr). Book the shuttle ahead for the night arrival.
